summary.headline: The Southborough Conservation Commission approved a pool project at 1 Overlook Drive and lifted a 2013 enforcement order on Lynbrook Road.
summary.summary: The Southborough Conservation Commission addressed multiple environmental and wetlands filings, granting an order of conditions for a residential pool at 1 Overlook Drive with required native plantings and construction protections. The commission also released a 2013 enforcement order against a property on Lynbrook Road after confirming compliance alongside state officials. Several larger hearings, including athletic field redevelopments at 0 Marlborough Junction and housing proposals on Turnpike Road and Southville Road, were continued to future meetings.

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The commission handled preliminary procedural items including approving minutes from the previous meeting.
key_details: Approved minutes from the prior meeting by roll-call vote.

topics.title: Notice of Intent: 1 Overlook Drive pool construction
topics.summary: The commission reviewed an application by Ron Eppen to construct a swimming pool, cabana, and patio within the 100-foot wetland buffer zone. Discussion focused on whether vegetation clearing would occur beyond existing lawn, access protection for small machinery, and mitigation through native plantings. The commission paused the item briefly to allow the applicant's senior consultant to join, ultimately approving the project with conditions requiring eight native shrubs in perpetuity and pre-construction access inspection.
key_details: Project site is 1 Overlook Drive.
Work remains outside the 20-foot town no-build buffer zone.
Mitigation includes planting eight native shrubs (equal split of northern spicebush and sweet pepperbush) to be maintained in perpetuity.
Contractor McCarthy Pools will review equipment access protections within the 20-foot strip with the conservation agent during a pre-construction site visit.
topics.outcome: Hearing closed and order of conditions approved

topics.title: Notice of Intent: 0 Marlborough Junction athletic fields
topics.summary: The commission considered a continuance request for the proposed relocation and reconstruction of athletic fields, including converting natural grass fields to artificial turf at 0 Marlborough Junction (Map 91, Lot 6). One commissioner recused themselves from the matter.
key_details: Address is 0 Marlborough Junction, Map 91 Lot 6.
Covers athletic field reconstruction and conversion to artificial turf.
Commissioner recused herself from deliberation and voting.

topics.title: Certificate of Compliance: 27 Pine Hill Road
topics.summary: The conservation agent reported on a request for a Certificate of Compliance for an in-ground pool installed in a riverfront area under DEP file 290-1128. An on-site split rail fence was installed, native shrubs were established, and the site is stable with no erosion.
key_details: Property located at 27 Pine Hill Road.
DEP file number 290-1128.
Agent confirmed site stability and compliance with all conditions.

topics.title: Certificate of Compliance: 21 Southville Road
topics.summary: The commission evaluated a request for a Certificate of Compliance under DEP file 290-1142 regarding the conversion of a porch to a sunroom and patio addition within the buffer zone. The conservation agent confirmed the work is complete, a natural fence buffer is preserved, and the area is stable.
key_details: Property located at 21 Southville Road.
DEP file number 290-1142.
Work is fully completed with stable soils.

topics.title: Enforcement order release: 6 Lynbrook Road
topics.summary: The commission reviewed an outstanding 2013 enforcement order recorded on the deed of 6 Lynbrook Road, discovered during a title search for an ongoing home sale. The order involved an unpermitted small retaining wall and mowing on adjacent Department of Conservation and Recreation (DCR) aqueduct land. The conservation agent inspected the site, verified the wall on state land was removed, and confirmed with DCR that all issues have been settled.
key_details: Address is 6 Lynbrook Road; enforcement order dates back to 2013.
Homeowners removed the wall section on DCR land and ceased unpermitted mowing.
DCR confirmed no pending issues exist on their property.
Action clears the cloud on the property deed.

topics.title: Department updates: Budget, Route 9 beaver flooding, and upcoming filings
topics.summary: The conservation agent provided operational updates, noting that the FY28 budget draft and explanation memo will be submitted as previously agreed. She reported that recurring flooding on Route 9 near 344 Turnpike Road is caused by beaver dams on the adjacent Madison Place property, and the town is attempting to contact property management alongside the Massachusetts Department of Transportation. Future agenda filings are expected soon for a Costco project, a Stonebrook septic repair, and an Eagle Scout trail bridge.
key_details: FY28 conservation budget submission will proceed to town administration.
Route 9 flooding near 344 Turnpike Road is traced to beaver dams on private property.
MassDOT has sent unacknowledged letters to Madison Place management; the town agent will follow up directly.
Upcoming applications anticipated for Costco and a Stonebrook septic system repair.

topics.title: Notice of Intent: 250 Turnpike Road and 0 Parkerville Road
topics.summary: The commission took up a continued hearing for a proposed 32-unit rental townhouse development at 250 Turnpike Road and 0 Parkerville Road. The conservation agent confirmed that peer reviewer Lucas Environmental is still completing their review, necessitating a continuance.
key_details: Project involves 32 rental townhouse units.
Locations are 250 Turnpike Road and 0 Parkerville Road.
Lucas Environmental peer review is expected prior to the next session.

topics.title: Notice of Intent: 0 Southville Road apartments
topics.summary: The commission addressed a Notice of Intent and stormwater management permit application for the construction of two apartment buildings and site work at 0 Southville Road. With a continuance requested and no applicant representative present, the commission voted to continue the hearing.
key_details: Proposal covers two apartment buildings and associated site work.
Applicant requested a continuance.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing for Notice of Intent and stormwater management permit for 0 Marlborough Junction
Issue a Certificate of Compliance for DEP number 290-1128 at 27 Pine Hill Road
Issue a Certificate of Compliance for DEP number 290-1142 at 21 Southville Road

Continue the Notice of Intent hearing for 250 Turnpike Road and 0 Parkerville Road

Continue the Notice of Intent and stormwater management hearing for 0 Southville Road

Next regular Conservation Commission meeting with continued hearings for 0 Marlborough Junction, 250 Turnpike Road, and 0 Southville Road
